title: Business Analyst
description:
**Key Responsibilities :**

* Understand and gather business and project requirements from clients and internal teams.
* Prepare and maintain BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, Acceptance Criteria, and other requirement documents.
* Create process flows, workflow diagrams, user flows, and functional specifications for development and QA teams.
* Create basic wireframes, mockups, and prototypes using Figma or similar tools.
* Work closely with clients, developers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers to ensure smooth project execution.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and basic feasibility analysis for new ideas and client requirements.
* Use AI tools for research, documentation, requirement analysis, and improving business processes.
* Review developed features and check whether they match the approved requirements.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and help identify and clarify issues.
* Keep project documentation updated and ensure any changes in requirements are properly recorded and communicated.

**Required Skills :**

* Must have 01 to 02 years of experience as a Business Analyst in an IT/software services company.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, BCA, MCA, or a related technical field.
* Hands\-on experience with Figma or similar wireframing/prototyping tools.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and sprint planning.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, APIs, and software development processes.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Architect, Data & Analytics
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific. **Principal Architect, Data \& Analytics**


The role of Principal Architect, Data \& Analytics, will play a pivotal role in strategic data \& analytics initiatives. This role will lead a team of technical leads and engineers focused on tools and technologies such as Azure Synapse, PowerBI, Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and other related technologies. Responsibilities include developing and executing the organization's data \& analytics strategy, managing related processes, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, implementing advanced analytics techniques, deploying data visualization tools, staying updated on industry trends, and providing leadership to the data and analytics team to foster continuous learning and development. This role will provide thought leadership in data \& analytics, Analytics cloud management, technology leadership, cloud governance, security, and self\-service management. Also, providing guidance and mentorship to a group of data \& analytics leads and engineers.

**What you will do:**

* Develop and execute the organization's Data \& Analytics strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational priorities, and long\-term growth initiatives.
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities where data\-driven insights can improve decision\-making, performance, and business outcomes.
* Drive the design, implementation, and optimization of scalable data architectures, analytics platforms, and reporting solutions that support enterprise needs.
* Oversee the selection, deployment, and governance of analytics technologies, tools, and frameworks to enhance data accessibility and business intelligence capabilities.
* Ensure data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards are maintained across all analytics processes, systems, and initiatives.
* Provide strategic oversight of analytics programs and projects, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, and timelines while proactively managing risks and dependencies.
* Establish robust project governance practices, including change management, scope control, resource planning, and stakeholder communication.
* Influence and educate stakeholders on the value of data and analytics, translating complex insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners, including solution evaluation, contract negotiations, and successful implementation of third\-party capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement through innovation, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to strengthen organizational data maturity and business impact.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; Master's degree (MBA, MIS, or equivalent) preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in Data \& Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and enterprise analytics platforms, with a proven track record of delivering business value through data\-driven solutions.
* Strong expertise in modern data platforms and technologies, including Azure Synapse, Databricks, Apache Spark \& PySpark and related cloud\-based analytics ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers along with proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining Delta Live Tables (DLT) pipelines.
* Strong understanding of metadata\-driven ETL frameworks , dynamic pipeline development, and knowledge of Unity Catalog.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD practices, Git\-based source control, and deployment automation.
* Exposure to SAP data integration using SAP source system for enterprise scale data migration initiatives is preferred.
* Analytics, Data Engineering, or Microsoft Azure certifications are a plus; experience within a regulated industry such as Medical Devices, Healthcare, or Life Sciences is preferred.

  



Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Data Operations Analyst

**Job Description** **Role: Data Operations Analyst**

**Location: Gurgaon**


Every insight NIQ delivers starts with Operations getting it right.


Behind every report, every market trend, and every business decision our clients make is trusted, high\-quality data. As a Data Operations Analyst, you'll play a key role in making that happen.


Working within NIQ's global Operations function, you'll ensure market data is accurate, complete, and ready for delivery to some of the world's most recognized brands. You'll investigate data issues, validate information, and help maintain the quality standards our clients rely on.


But this role is about more than data quality.


Operations at NIQ is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history. Automation, AI\-enabled workflows, smarter technologies, and digital platforms are reshaping how we work. Rather than replacing human expertise, these technologies enable our teams to focus on critical thinking, solving complex problems, and continuously improving how we deliver value to clients.


From day one, you'll work alongside experienced colleagues in a collaborative global environment while developing future\-ready skills in data, technology, automation, and operational excellence.


If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to build a career where technology and human judgement work together, we'd love to hear from you.


What You'll Do

* Research product information and accurately classify and maintain data within NIQ databases.
* Perform quantitative and qualitative quality checks to ensure market data meets NIQ's global quality standards.
* Manage monthly production activities using NIQ's proprietary platforms, ensuring data is delivered accurately and on time.
* Investigate, analyze, and resolve data issues and exceptions.
* Monitor market developments and understand how they impact data quality.
* Work alongside AI\-enabled tools and automated workflows, applying critical thinking and human judgement to validate outputs and resolve exceptions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Use data and operational insights to identify trends, improve quality, and enhance performance.
* Collaborate with colleagues across global teams to deliver trusted, high\-quality data that supports client decision\-making.

 **Qualifications**  

* **Bachelor's degree is mandatory to apply for this role.**
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* English proficiency (B1\-B2 level or above).  



**Skills for Success**


We're looking for curious, adaptable people who are excited about learning and solving problems.


You'll thrive in this role if you have:
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and knowledge of Market Research.
* A passion for working with data and solving problems.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and digital tools.
* A growth mindset and willingness to embrace change.
* The ability to work effectively within structured processes while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* A commitment to delivering high\-quality work in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Nice to Have**
* Exposure to data processing or data quality activities.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled technologies or automation tools.
* Basic knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Python, or similar analytical tools.
* Experience improving or documenting operational processes.
* Structured onboarding and comprehensive training from day one.
* Cross\-functional collaboration within a global organisation.
* Commercial awareness and understanding how operational excellence creates value for clients.
* Change and transformation.
* Digital fluency.
* Performance analytics.
* Data\-driven decision\-making.
* Automation and process improvement.
* As Operations continues to evolve, you'll have opportunities to develop capabilities that are increasingly valuable across the industry, including:
* Working confidently alongside AI\-enabled technologies.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst I - SAP Security
description:
**A Day in Your Life at MKS:**


As a **Sr. SAP Security Analyst / BSA**, reporting to the Senior Manager of SAP ERP Applications, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting SAP Security and SAP GRC solutions across the global SAP landscape. You will work closely with business, application, infrastructure, audit, and compliance teams to ensure secure and compliant access to SAP applications.

**You Will Make an Impact By:**

**SAP Security \& Role Management:**  

Design, implement, maintain, and support SAP Security roles across various SAP products and projects. Develop and maintain role\-based access models, including RBAC, and ensure appropriate segregation of duties (SoD). Support SAP ECC 6\.0 EHP7/EHP8 environments, with knowledge of S/4HANA highly desired.

**SAP GRC Administration \& Access Governance:**  

Administer and support SAP GRC Access Control configuration, including rule sets, workflows, approvers, user provisioning, Emergency Access Management (EAM), and access recertification processes. Maintain SAP GRC master data and support the configuration and execution of risk analysis and mitigation activities.

**Access Reviews \& Compliance:**  

Configure and support user access review processes, workflows, and relevant parameters. Perform access and risk analysis and support audit and compliance activities. Work closely with internal and external auditors on SAP Security, SoD, SOX, and IT General Controls (ITGC) requirements.

**Incident \& Problem Management:**  

Provide support to AMS team in troubleshooting and resolve day\-to\-day SAP authorization, role, provisioning, and workflow\-related issues. Investigate access\-related incidents, identify root causes, and implement appropriate corrective actions while ensuring adherence to operational standards and service level commitments.

**Risk Management, Controls \& Audit:**  

Support IT risk management activities and help identify, assess, and address SAP\-related business and IT risks. Execute and maintain IT General Controls to ensure control effectiveness. Participate in audit discussions, respond to audit questions, and support the remediation of SoD, SOX, and security control issues.

**Project \& Stakeholder Management:**  

Work closely with PMO teams, SAP application teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to deliver SAP Security solutions and support project requirements. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams during SAP implementations, upgrades, role redesigns, and other security initiatives.

**Security Standards \& Documentation:**  

Ensure SAP Security and GRC processes comply with organizational security policies, controls, and best practices. Maintain accurate security documentation, technical specifications, procedures, and knowledge materials.

**SAP Security Operations \& Continuous Improvement:**


Identify opportunities to improve security processes, automation, and operational efficiency.

**Skills You Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent.
* **7–10 years of experience** in SAP Security and SAP GRC within global enterprise environments.
* Strong experience with **SAP Security role design, build, deployment, administration, and troubleshooting**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **SAP GRC Access Control**, including Access Risk Analysis, Access Request Management, Business Role Management, Emergency Access Management, workflows, and rule sets.
* Experience with **SAP ECC 6\.0 EHP7/EHP8**; knowledge of **SAP S/4HANA** highly desired.
* Proven experience with different SAP Security and role\-design models, including **RBAC**.
* Experience supporting SAP GRC upgrades and SAP system upgrade activities.
* Experience troubleshooting SAP GRC workflows, synchronization jobs, provisioning, and authorization issues.
* Strong understanding of **SoD, SOX, IT General Controls (ITGC), audit, and compliance requirements**.
* Experience working with internal and external auditors and supporting audit remediation activities.
* Knowledge of IT and business risk management and control frameworks.
* Experience working in a global enterprise environment and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, time management, and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a global environment.
* **Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.**
* Nice to have: Experience with **SAP Cloud security and identity**, including Ariba, C4C, and IBP.

title: Analyst-Data Analytics
description:
**Global Complaints \& Privacy Team** is responsible for servicing \& handling customer complaint channels across multiple international markets. title: Supply Chain Development Analyst
description:
Closing date for applications: 22/09/2026



Location Gurugram, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


\#R\-00284459

  



**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Supply Chain Systems \& Tooling Specialist


* In your new role, you'll combine data\-driven insight and technical expertise to support the delivery of end\-to\-end supply chain solutions, reporting enhancements and process optimisation initiatives
* You'll simplify and enhance supply chain systems, tools and processes, driving scalable solutions that improve efficiency, controls and user experience
* Gain recognition as a subject matter expert across supply chain platforms and processes, providing technical guidance and supporting continuous improvement and business change
* We're offering this role at associate level

**What you’ll do**
------------------


As our Supply Chain Systems \& Tooling Specialist, you’ll analyse, configure and enhance end\-to\-end supply chain solutions, optimising systems, processes and performance. You’ll translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions, using analytics to support decision\-making and drives continuous improvement across supply chain platforms and tools. Building strong stakeholder and supplier relationships, you’ll provide operational support and subject matter expertise to drive adoption and continuous improvement.


Your work will focus on:


* Designing and delivering end\-to\-end supply chain and technology solutions, translating business requirements into practical and scalable outcomes.
* Providing technical expertise across supply chain systems and processes, supporting system enhancements, process improvements and effective solution delivery.
* Configuring and maintaining supply chain platforms, including workflows, user access, permissions and system administration activities
* Supporting release management, testing and deployment activities, making sure changes are controlled, compliant and aligned to governance standards
* Monitoring system performance, incidents and data quality, taking action to maintain platform stability, integrity and effective controls
* Supporting reporting enhancements, data remediation and optimisation initiatives, while capturing and documenting business and technical requirements

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------


To succeed in this role, you’ll bring experience of system configuration, administration and technical solution delivery, ideally across Jaggaer, Ariba, Coupa, ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Power BI and Power Automate. You’ll also have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including experience working with complex data sets and translating insight into practical solutions.


You’ll also bring:


* An understanding of supply chain processes and third\-party environments
* The ability to translate business challenges into effective technical solutions
* Experience working with Agile and structured change delivery frameworks
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* The ability to communicate technical impacts clearly to support informed decision\-making
* Good organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Minimum of 8 years of work experience is required; Agile certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), and ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification are desirable.

**Welcome to our Gurugram hub**
-------------------------------


Spanning 437,000 sq. ft., our campus in Gurugram features two state\-of\-the\-art towers – 1A and 2A at the Candor TechSpace in Sector 21\.


### **Key facts:**


* Surrounded by 28 acres
* Space for 4,100 colleagues
